title: State apportionment and a liquidation — Vega Corp.
instructions: Answer the questions about Vega Corp.'s state taxes and a liquidation of another company.

exhibits.title: Vega Corp. — State X
exhibits.content:
- Business income (all states): **$3,000,000**
- Nonbusiness dividends: **$200,000** (commercial domicile: State Z)

| Factor | State X | Everywhere |
|---|---:|---:|
| Sales | 2,400,000 | 12,000,000 |
| Property | 3,000,000 | 10,000,000 |
| Payroll | 1,500,000 | 6,000,000 |

Vega also ships **$600,000** of goods from its State X warehouse to customers in State W, where Vega is protected by P.L. 86-272.

exhibits.title: Lark Inc. — complete liquidation
exhibits.content:
- Lark distributes land (basis **$100,000**; FMV **$400,000**) and **$100,000** cash to its sole shareholder, Mo.
- Mo's stock basis: **$150,000**.
- Ignore Lark's tax on the liquidation for Mo's computation.

parts.prompt: State X apportionment (State X sales above exclude the State W shipments).
